fi
if [[ $d_fd7 == 1 ]]; then if exec 7>&-; then :; else d_cleanup+=,close_7:$?; d_close_error=1; fi; fi
if [[ $d_fd8 == 1 ]]; then if exec 8>&-; then :; else d_cleanup+=,close_8:$?; d_close_error=1; fi; fi
if [[ -n $d_opid ]]; then if builtin wait "$d_opid"; then d_os=0; else d_os=$?; d_cleanup+=,O:$d_os; fi; fi
if [[ -n $d_epid ]]; then if builtin wait "$d_epid"; then d_es=0; else d_es=$?; d_cleanup+=,E:$d_es; fi; fi
if [[ $d_dispatched == 1 ]]; then
builtin printf 'D1 dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd S %s %s %s %s\n' "${d_ps[1]}" "$d_os" "$d_es" "${d_ps[0]}" >&9
fi
if [[ $d_fd9 == 1 ]]; then if exec 9>&-; then :; else d_cleanup+=,close_9:$?; d_close_error=1; fi; fi
if [[ -n $d_rpid ]]; then if builtin wait "$d_rpid"; then d_rs=0; else d_rs=$?; d_cleanup+=,relay:$d_rs; fi; fi
if [[ $d_saved_ok == 1 ]]; then
if /usr/bin/python3 -I -B -S -c 'import base64;exec(base64.b64decode('"'"'aW1wb3J0IHRlcm1pb3MsanNvbixzeXM7IHM9anNvbi5'\
